Thus a final `assert = …}` becomes `assert = …}[[rules]]`. This violates REQ-01/03 for hand-authored content and can make the addressable registry unreadable. Existing preservation tests only use newline-terminated files. References: @/charter/D-6.

2. **Blocking · issue-impact · high** — The structural splitter treats `\n[[rules]]` inside a valid multiline TOML string as a table boundary at [crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:169](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:169). The TOML identity parse then reports fewer rules than raw blocks and synchronization aborts at line 240, after `config.toml` may already have been saved. A custom rule description containing that line therefore leaves membership stale, contrary to REQ-01–03. References: @/charter/D-6.
